units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:10">Erub. X, 10</cite> <he>נגר שיש בראשו ג׳</he> a door bolt which has on its top a (movable) fastening contrivance (which may occasionally be used as a pestle).

<cite ref="Shabbat 123b:14">Sabb. 123ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="S00001"><he>ק׳</he></cite>, Ms. M. repeatedly <he>גלוסקר׳</he>) the law about claustra, ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:4">Kel. XI, 4</cite> <cite ref="S00001"><he>ק׳</he></cite>.
